raw_definitions: Definisi : she invited ~ well everybody in the office to the party, dia menjemput hampir semua orang di pejabatnya utk menghadiri jamuan itu; the family was ~ well exhausted after the long journey, keluarga itu sangat letih selepas perjalanan yg jauh; relations between the two have been ~ well strained, hubungan antara kedua-duanya sangat tegang.
